subject.title: fix(publication): ratchet new review revisions above the publication head

question: Should the remaining `refreshExactReviewPublicationItem` revision-1 recovery path be accepted as a separately tracked visible failure, or must it be included in this fix before merge?
rationale: The PR deliberately leaves one known creation path below the publication watermark because threading durable storage into that helper broadens the patch; deciding whether the residual recovery failure is acceptable is an operational scope choice.

options.title: Merge and track refresh recovery
options.body: Accept this focused fix because it repairs normal enqueue and dead-letter recovery while the workflow now exposes any remaining artifact-refresh supersession.

options.title: Extend this PR
options.body: Require artifact-refresh recovery to seed above the same publication head before merging, increasing scope but removing the known residual path.
